status: Installed and normal UI restored on iPhone 11 Pro Max and iPhone 17 Pro Max.
user_controls: History > session details > On this phone shows local file size.
Remove replay from this phone removes replay, edit/analysis/spin sidecars, matching temporary import copies and shared rebuildable video caches; keeps the result.
Delete session from this phone additionally removes its local history row and sidecars. A durable local marker prevents cloud refresh, queued results or late saves from recreating the local session.
Settings > Storage, also accessible from the History toolbar, shows saved-session and cached-file sizes with confirmed Clear cache.
Debug builds expose a separate, confirmed removal of known benchmark-file namespaces.
cleanup: Cache clearing removes Library/Caches files, history analysis/spin caches, temporary exports, and temporary import copies proven byte-identical to retained originals. Keeps saved videos, compact counting records, edits, preferences and unsaved/unmatched sources.
New retained originals record their owned temporary source. Closing the session editor schedules byte-verified cleanup after saving and active video readers finish.
Atomic reader/maintenance admission prevents processing and cleanup from overlapping across actor boundaries. Cached in-memory results are released before deleting their files.

Session deletion waits for the video-copy task and analysis writes. Local deletion and replay-removal markers reject late copy/editor commits. Interrupted local deletion is reconciled on history reload.
File enumeration does not follow symlinks. Temporary-import deletion is limited to app-generated UUID movie names in the owned temporary directory.
scope: Local device storage only; Photos and account/leaderboard results are preserved.
Other saved session videos and edits survive cache clearing; processing data may need rebuilding.
Deleting a session also clears shared transient video-processing caches; retained analyses of other sessions remain available.
No real user session was intentionally deleted by this task. UI tests use a separate library, cache root and guest-defaults suite.
